title: Use pipe handles with explicit ownership and platform-aware I/O
goal: Use low-level pipe handles without seeking assumptions, and inspect Unix async state and same-user named-pipe permissions before migrating handle-based I/O.

selectionNotes: Use low-level pipe handles without seeking assumptions, and inspect Unix async state and same-user named-pipe permissions before migrating handle-based I/O.

Actual Windows x64 and digest-pinned Linux x64 old/new execution; current handle types, four pipe-end flag combinations, ownership, EOF, regular-file async reads, SendPacketsElement constructor guards and Unix 0600 shared-path ratchet. Same-user only; RC2 is not GA proof.
